$comment: Pinned build inputs for FileAlchemy. Hashes are verified by
scripts/fetch-engines.ps1 before anything is extracted into bin/.
A blank sha256 is treated as 'not yet reviewed' and blocks installation
unless the maintainer re-runs the script with -Update, which records the
observed hash deliberately instead of trusting it silently.

engines.name: ffmpeg
engines.notes: lgpl build keeps redistribution terms simple; includes libx264, libvpx, libopus, libmp3lame.

engines.name: pandoc
engines.notes: Single static executable; invoked as a separate process, so the GPL does not extend to FileAlchemy.

engines.name: poppler
engines.notes: pdftoppm.exe needs the sibling poppler DLLs; the packaging script copies them next to it.
